effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned, you can select 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Deck and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the Normal/Flip Summon trigger resolves with no Ritual Spell left in the Deck, the goat script proves the whiff by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is behaviourally unchanged across the whole lineage.

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned, you can select 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Deck and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Separate per-card ruling: the goat script drops the modern activation requirement that a Ritual Spell actually be in the Deck - the target function's 'if chk==0 then return Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil) end' becomes 'if chk==0 then return true end' - so the optional trigger may be activated on a search that cannot find anything. Nothing in the packet dates when this card lost its fail-to-find allowance (the shared verification chronology explicitly does not cover it), so the chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v2 (SYE-021, exact cdb match); v0/v1 (MRL, 2002) predate it and only swap 'Magic'->'Spell' and summon wording. Trailing lineage v2 -> v6 (SBAD-EN011) is cosmetic: 'select ... and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck' -> 'add ... to your hand', PSCT colon, 'Ritual Spell Card' -> 'Ritual Spell'. One lineage oddity: v3 (GLD1-EN002, 2008) reads 'add 1 Ritual Spell Card' with no 'you can', which later printings (v4 RP01-EN075, v5, v6) and both scripts restore as optional, so no functional flip is recorded; the packet's Retro Pack NA date (2024-08-23) is anomalous against its EU date (2008-07-08) but nothing here is dated from that printing. The script's filter change (c:IsRitualSpell() -> c:GetType()==0x82) is the same test written with the raw TYPE_SPELL|TYPE_RITUAL mask. The two ruling changes are entangled in play - the reveal is only reachable because the activation condition is relaxed - but they are recorded separately because only the reveal half has sourced bounds; the state between them needs no implementation, as GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
